subtitle: Lesson 72 · PostgreSQL Backup & Recovery

eyebrow: The WAL: log first, then data
code:
Every change -> written to WAL first
(same discipline as the SQL Server transaction log)

archive_mode = on
archive_command = 'cp %p /mnt/wal-archive/%f'

%p = path to segment, %f = filename
caption: Archiving hands off each completed WAL segment before it's recycled.

code:
restore_command = 'cp /mnt/wal-archive/%f %p'
recovery_target_time = '2026-09-19 14:32:00'

1. restore base backup
2. set restore_command + recovery_target_time
3. start PostgreSQL, it replays to the target
caption: The PostgreSQL equivalent of RESTORE LOG ... WITH STOPAT.
